menu.tag: Night falls on the clearing. Your weapons fire on their own: move, jump and make it through all three worlds.
menu.ctrl.move: Move (joystick under your thumb on mobile, left stick on a gamepad)
menu.ctrl.spell: Your class spell (each character has their own)
menu.ctrl.pick: Pick an upgrade at every level
menu.ctrl.worlds: Before the timer runs out, activate the totem (red diamond on the map) and kill its boss: the portal leads to the next world. Once time is up, the horde keeps growing.
menu.resetNote: New progression: everyone starts over. Your settings are kept.
menu.iosHint: On iPhone: Share, then “Add to Home Screen”

board.title: Leaderboard
board.signIn: Sign in to see the leaderboard and appear on it.

board.pickPseudo: Pick a nickname in Account to appear on the leaderboard.
board.none: Finish a run to show up here.
account.pseudo.label: Leaderboard nickname
account.pseudo.invalid: Nickname: 2 to 16 letters, digits, spaces, - or _.
account.title: Account
account.intro: An account keeps your progress (record, gold, shop, achievements) and restores it on another device; with a nickname, your best scores join the leaderboard (visible to signed-in players only). Your settings stay on this device. It's optional: without an account, everything stays here.
account.status.unavailable: Accounts are not available in this build of the game.
account.sync.offline: Offline: progress will sync when the network is back.
account.iosHint: In the installed app the Google window may not open: use e-mail and password, or open ruee-nocturne.web.app in Safari.
account.resetSent: E-mail sent: follow the link to choose a new password.
account.signedOut: Signed out. Your progress stays on this device.
account.delete: Delete my account and its data
account.deleteArm: Tap again to delete the account, its online save and your leaderboard scores. Your progress stays on this device.
account.deletePwd: Confirm your password to delete the account
account.deleteDone: Account deleted. Your progress stays on this device.
account.choice.text: This device and your account each have a save. Which one do you keep? The other will be replaced.

account.err.operation-not-allowed: This sign-in method is not enabled.
